commitResults.messageBody:
Give the chatbot its own identity instead of the template's
placeholder name: rename the class and file, and replace the
ASCII-art banner so it spells CHIONE.

Also fill in the student profile fields in AGENTS.md.

Chione now reads user commands in a loop and echoes each one back,
exiting on 'bye'. Output formatting is extracted into printBlock()
so later increments can reuse the divider-wrapped reply shape.
